title: Getting Started with Convex
subtitle: A beginner's guide to real-time sync
text: Convex is a brand new type of backend-as-a-service that replaces your database, API layer, and state management completely over live WebSockets.
author: Alice Vance

title: Mastering Material-UI DataGrid
subtitle: Server-side pagination made simple
text: When building admin dashboards with complex grids, offloading your data processing tasks like sorting, filtering, and page limitations to the database ensures smooth operation.
author: Bob Miller

title: The Future of Web Applications
subtitle: Why state synchronization is shifting
text: Traditional HTTP request-response APIs are being replaced by lightweight state caches streaming over persistent channels. This reduces complex frontend data refetching loops.
author: Alice Vance
